info.description:
Authentication Service (authentication-service) — 86 operations.

GENERATED from the OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec published at the UAT gateway swagger-ui
(Select a definition -> "Authentication Service APIs"). Request bodies are schema-derived placeholders (lorem-ipsum
strings, sample numbers) — replace with real values before sending.

Base URL: {{gatewayBaseUrl}}/authentication-service  (gatewayBaseUrl lives in EMI-dev.postman_environment.json).
Spec server: https://gateway-emiuat.dg-cash.app/authentication-service

AUTH: the spec declares no security scheme, but the gateway front-doors every route with a bearer
token. Set {{token}} in the environment (mint one with the Authentication Service collection's
sign-in, or pass --env-var token=... to newman). Some back-office routes need an admin/service
token rather than a merchant one.
